title: tests.py records each run's scope, time and per-file durations
goal: tests.py appends one ops test.run row per run: mode (full, changed, fast or stress), selected and total test files, workers, milliseconds, exit, counts of passed, failed and skipped, the slowest files with their milliseconds and, for a full run, every file's; failed test file names (never test ids) are shape-checked and capped; _tools/test_durations.json of ST-t7xxgt47 is derived from these rows.

gates.question: How does a tests.py run map to test.run rows and modes?

notes: Failure it answers: the suite's run times and load timeouts are known only from reports written by hand (EP-hlnsqx4f); tests.py also changes in ST-g73vlg44 and ST-t7xxgt47, so these run one after another.
